# ziti_proxy_v1_config (Resource)

Ziti proxy v1 config Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ziti_proxy_v1_config" "test_proxy_v1_config" {
  name      = "test.proxy.v1"
  port      = 8000
  protocols = ["tcp"]
  binding   = "transport"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the config
- `port` (Number) The port to listen on.
- `protocols` (List of String) Protocols that the proxy will listen on.

### Optional

- `binding` (String) The binding to use for this proxy config.
- `config_type_id` (String) The Id of a config-type
- `tags` (Map of String) Config Tags

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated Time

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# proxy v1 config can be imported by specifying the identifier.
terraform import ziti_proxy_v1_config.test_proxy_v1_config <ID>
```
